newsitem.title: USA: Osmonics says lower margins continuing.
newsitem.headline: Osmonics says lower margins continuing.

text.p: Osmonics Inc said is it continuing to see lower gross profit margins due to product mix.
The maker of water purifying and handling systems said first-quarter gross margin was 38.6 percent, versus 41.0 percent in the year-ago period.
"We are actively evaluating the best methods to increase gross margins while continuing good sales growth," said chief executive Dean Spatz.

"As we look toward the upcoming year we continue to be optimistic. We have nearly a full complement of field sales personnel; our sales are 50-percent replaceable products; new products are being introduced; and we believe our G&A expense can be reduced," Spatz said.
"Our primary challenge is to increase gross margins to our historical 42 percent of sales," he said.
